integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from character orthogonality, a complete four-point difference-profile classification, and exact phase minimization. The finite verifier is corroborative only. Originality was compared against full text of the closest unimodular- and Littlewood-polynomial sources; the inaccessible full text of Newman--Byrnes remains a stated residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Specific to prime cyclic groups with p>=11, four-point supports, and equal nonzero coefficient magnitudes. It does not classify p=5 or p=7, composite moduli, other support sizes, unequal magnitudes, all critical points, or all minimizing phase vectors.
title: Four-point support geometry quantizes the phase-only fourth Fourier moment
